integrity: Exact analytic proof and a self-contained numerical consistency checker; finite tests are not a substitute for proof.
scientific_limitations: The complete fixed-origin second-coefficient frontier is derived only for origins t at least ((q-1)/q)^q, q=2/p; no classification below this cutoff or at higher Taylor orders. Proof depends on the published outer-extremal theorem and first-coefficient frontier. Historical publication priority and independent audit remain unverified.
title: All-exponent second-jet Hardy extremals and the sharp Wiener terminal threshold
